overview_description.description: Carwow is the smart way to choose and buy a new car. The company helps to connect car buyers to car dealers to make the process as efficient and cost-effective as possible while enabling consumers to interact with an official dealer throughout the transaction process. The company's dealer partners sell more cars in the showroom alone while reducing cost inefficiencies and improving stock turnover.

product.name: Carwow Online Car Marketplace
product.description: An online platform that connects customers with automotive brands and dealers to buy or sell new and used cars without fees or haggling.

product.name: Carwow Car Finder Tool
product.description: A digital tool that helps users search and filter new and used cars by brand, body type, price, and features to find suitable vehicles.

product.name: Carwow Sell My Car Service
product.description: A service that enables users to sell their cars by submitting details and receiving competitive offers from a network of dealers, with collection arranged upon sale.

product.name: Carwow Lease Deals Platform
product.description: An online service providing users with lease options for new cars, allowing them to compare monthly payments and terms from various dealers.

product.description: A collection of online tools and informational resources focused on electric vehicles, including charging point maps and cost comparisons.
